svg.aria-label: JoyHome KNX kernel. Linux kernel. A current Linux 6.18 LTS kernel for the JoyHome KNX home server (Rockchip RK3566), which only shipped with a 2022 kernel. Includes the early hardware watchdog that stops ready-made kernels from booting it, and rebuilds itself every month.
